sections.section_label: Opening discussion: male friendship and place

themes.theme_definition: This theme captures participants' preference for places offering reasonably priced food and beverages when spending time with friends.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: It's a nice place with cheap beer and a good place to go.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 2
verified_quotes.quote: It's, um (.), got reasonably priced food. It's got a nice selection of food.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: It's on like a rooftop, so that's probably where we go most often, and it's decent price, and easy to get to for all of us to meet up.

themes.theme_definition: This theme highlights how participants choose locations that align with common activities or passions they share with their male friends.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 4
verified_quotes.quote: Um, so my favourite place in the city is a place called Driving Simulator, where you can drive Formula 1 cars, as a simulation with my friends. Um, because we all share the same hobby.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 5
verified_quotes.quote: My favourite place in the city is, um, Old Trafford, that's, um, in Manchester. That is where I do like to have fun with my male friends. We go watch, um, Manchester United matches and all.

themes.theme_definition: This theme describes the approach of deciding what to eat spontaneously, often based on what is available or what everyone feels like at the moment.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 3
verified_quotes.quote: Most times there's no, uh, plan on getting what to eat. We just get here and, uh, see what, uh, what is available and everybody picks their choices.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: It just kind of depends what everyone's feeling, I guess.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 4
verified_quotes.quote: How do we decide what to eat? It's in the city centre, so we can just go anywhere to be honest, and eat anywhere.

themes.theme_definition: This theme captures how participants' food choices are often swayed by what others in their group are craving or suggesting.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: Uh, kind of just depends what we're all feeling, to be honest.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 3
verified_quotes.quote: Most times we jump on each other's cravings. Just if one person just says, I want to go for burger, then you see everybody trying to go for burger.

themes.theme_definition: This theme describes participants' habit of ordering the same familiar dishes, especially for certain types of cuisine.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 2
verified_quotes.quote: typically I usually have burgers but I've really tried to not have that and actually try something different for a change.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: but like burgers and pizzas, I'm usually just going to get the exact same thing every time.

themes.theme_definition: This theme highlights the impact of having many different dining choices, particularly in a city center, on decision-making.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: then there's loads of places around it so we just pick one after that.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 4
verified_quotes.quote: So the city centre has like over 50 places to eat, so I can just go anywhere.

themes.theme_definition: This theme captures participants' differing views on whether gender plays a role in the types of food they choose to eat.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 3
verified_quotes.quote: I think, uh, the male uh, the male just has a free mind about eating things and, uh, they don't really (.), there's not really an influence to the agenda like that.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 5
verified_quotes.quote: I do think gender does, because as a male, I guess there are certain things I am meant to take, which ladies might take and I might not take.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 4
verified_quotes.quote: Um, I don't think gender influences what I eat. Maybe how much I eat with my like guy friends compared to my girls that are friends.

themes.theme_definition: This theme highlights the observation that participants tend to eat larger quantities or more substantial meals when in the company of male friends.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 2
verified_quotes.quote: if you're with, um, your male friends, then if you're out, you do feel like you do need to eat more. So I, again, you would go for burgers or pizzas and get bigger ones

themes.theme_definition: This theme describes the tendency of participants to make food decisions primarily based on their immediate desires or cravings rather than external influences.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 5
verified_quotes.quote: It's just, um, probably what we want to eat for that particular moment, food for the moment, probably whatever we are craving to eat.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: I don't think I've ever made a decision on where to eat on like, any influences, like gender-wise. Um, so I would say no, for where we would eat.

themes.theme_definition: This theme captures participants' recognition that adopting a plant-based diet would necessitate extensive changes to their eating habits, cooking styles, and overall daily routines.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: Um, we eat quite a lot of meat to be honest, like me and my partner, so, probably need to change a lot, like completely change like what recipes we know.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 4
verified_quotes.quote: I think my whole, like, diet would have to change because, um, I'm quite fond of the gym, so I have, like, protein in every meal.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 3
verified_quotes.quote: It's going to really, a lot of things have to change. Because, one, I'm an athlete, I, uh, I go gymming every time, I go training almost every time like that.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 5
verified_quotes.quote: Going plant based. I guess a lot of things have changed because I am basically new and trying to adapt. So I would have to work on my diet.

themes.theme_label: Impact on athletic and fitness routines
themes.theme_definition: This theme highlights participants' concerns about how a plant-based diet would affect their ability to maintain their current fitness levels, strength training, and protein intake.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 4
verified_quotes.quote: I'm quite fond of the gym, so I have, like, protein in every meal. So, like, chicken, tuna, beef.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 3
verified_quotes.quote: Because, one, I'm an athlete, I, uh, I go gymming every time, I go training almost every time like that.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 5
verified_quotes.quote: I have friends who are gym rats, who love to go to the gym together, who love to do strength training and the like.

themes.theme_label: Challenges with taste and food substitutes
themes.theme_definition: This theme captures participants' skepticism and dissatisfaction regarding the taste and quality of plant-based meat substitutes and the perceived blandness of plant-based meals.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 2
verified_quotes.quote: And I'm not keen on the fake products, like the fake sausages, the fake bacon, any of that, because it’s just...

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: It's just a bit bland, innit, sometimes? It just doesn't taste right.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 2
verified_quotes.quote: yeah, it's just not the same thing.

themes.theme_label: Need for new knowledge and recipes
themes.theme_definition: This theme reflects participants' understanding that adopting a plant-based diet would require them to actively seek out new information, learn different recipes, and educate themselves on plant-based nutrition.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: So maybe try different shops as well to see if there's any better and just look up different recipes and just learn a bit more about going plant based.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 4
verified_quotes.quote: change my whole cooking style, find new recipes, and I think it'd be a lot of effort.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 5
verified_quotes.quote: I would have to get more education and enlightenment concerning plant based.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 2
verified_quotes.quote: but again, you just need to learn what different things you could make.

themes.theme_definition: This theme captures participants' desire for plant-based foods to have better flavor, more substantial texture, and overall improved palatability to be more appealing.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: Um more appealing is that you've got to make them taste better, I would say, first of all. Like, you've got to give them a bit more flavour and a bit more.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 2
verified_quotes.quote: Again (.), um, about the like the actual ingredients. As well, I think that needs to be what's actually going into this. What am I actually eating here?

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: I think the biggest thing is like, try to make it so I don't, I don't know that I'm not eating meat would be the best way.

themes.theme_definition: This theme reflects participants' concerns about unfamiliar ingredients in plant-based foods and their desire for clearer information and education about what these products contain.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 4
verified_quotes.quote: So, if, if the ingredient list was a bit shorter and I was familiar with it, maybe it would be more appealing to me.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: If there was just like a bit more education around what goes in it as well, I guess. If it was more commonly known about like, look, this is what we're putting in instead of chicken or that.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 2
verified_quotes.quote: Um, I think more education about it would be good. Again (.), um, about the like the actual ingredients.

themes.theme_definition: This theme highlights the barrier of high cost for plant-based alternatives and the need for them to be more affordable to compete with traditional food options.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 1
verified_quotes.quote: Um, and just maybe make it a bit, because some of it's quite expensive as well. Like if you want to go for that like alternative plant based, it can be more expensive and I think that puts off a lot of people.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 2
verified_quotes.quote: And, you know, the price is really, it is expensive. If you want to compete with that, you need to bring it, you need to try and make it as best as possible, but you kind of need to make it, um, for the average person to be able to afford it, you know, week after week doing their shopping.

themes.theme_definition: This theme captures participants' recognition of the potential health advantages of plant-based foods, such as lower calories and benefits for blood sugar regulation and weight management.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 3
verified_quotes.quote: Yeah, plant based. I think mostly plant based are vegetables. I don't know. Yeah, I bet it was. I read that back there in Nigeria. Uh, some vegetables like that, uh, mostly, you know, they are plant based and they are good for the body, very good for the body, uh, uh, good for the heart, uh, and it makes you, it makes you, uh, it makes you watch your body very well, and they are good for with, uh, uh, for checking of your weight also mostly.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 5
verified_quotes.quote: Um, plant based foods might be appealing to me in the sense that (.), um, they contain less calories. It helps in, uh, regulating your blood sugar, preventing diabetes. It's also many health, um, advantages with it.

themes.theme_definition: This theme highlights the need for practical suggestions and inspiration on how to incorporate plant-based foods into daily meals beyond common substitutes.

verified_quotes.speaker: Participant 2
verified_quotes.quote: Um, and then maybe some, I don't know, recipe ideas, like what can I actually do with this? Because the things that just pop into my head are the fake sausages and the fake bacon, but what, you know, you're not going to have that in a roll.
